translation_unit_protected_source_text: To our knowledge, this is the first manifestation of this effect in ortho-lithioanilines. The reason is that this effect is generally "hidden" behind a much stronger coordination of the directing group to the lithium atom. Thus, according to our quantum chemical calculations, the rotation of the NMe₂ group in 2-lithio-N,N-dimethylaniline complex with toluene first leads to a slight increase of the electronic energy with a maximum of +0.6 kcal/mol at approximately 30° (Figure 7). Further rotation leads to the stabilization via coordination of nitrogen to lithium with up to −6.8 kcal/mol at 120°. In total, the loss in conjugation energy is negligibly small and does not affect the halogen–lithium exchange in simple anilines and becomes noticeable only in strained substrates like 12b. Thus, a similar rotation of the N(2)Me group in 12b·Tol leads to the dramatically higher increase of the electronic energy with a maximum of +7.4 kcal/mol at approximately 75° and further coordination to the lithium atom brings a stabilization of only 2.9 kcal/mol at 80° (Figure 8). Further rotation forces the inversion of the N(1)Me group, allowing its effective conjugation with the aromatic core, which noticeably stabilizes the system but nevertheless leaves the process thermodynamically unfavorable.
translation_unit_protected_translated_te: 据我们所知，这是该效应在邻位锂代苯胺中的首次体现。其原因在于，该效应通常被导向基团与锂原子之间更强的配位作用所“掩盖”。因此，根据我们的量子化学计算，在2-锂代-N,N-二甲基苯胺与甲苯的络合物中，NMe₂ 基团的旋转首先导致电子能量小幅升高，在约 30° 时达到最大值 +0.6 kcal/mol（图 7）。进一步旋转则通过氮与锂的配位产生稳定化作用，在 120° 时稳定化能达 −6.8 kcal/mol。总体而言，共轭能的损失极小，不影响简单苯胺中的卤素–锂交换，仅在类似 12b 这样的张紧底物中才变得显著。例如，在 12b·Tol 中，N(2)Me 基团的类似旋转导致电子能量大幅升高，在约 75° 时达到最大值 +7.4 kcal/mol，而与锂原子的进一步配位仅在 80° 时带来 2.9 kcal/mol 的稳定化（图 8）。继续旋转迫使 N(1)Me 基团发生翻转，使其能够与芳香核心有效共轭，这虽然显著稳定了体系，但仍使该过程在热力学上不利。

Further rotation leads to the stabilization via coordination of nitrogen to lithium with up to −6.8 kcal/mol at 120°. In total, the loss in conjugation energy is negligibly small and does not affect the halogen–lithium exchange in simple anilines and becomes noticeable only in strained substrates like 12b. Thus, a similar rotation of the N(2)Me group in 12b·Tol leads to the dramatically higher increase of the electronic energy with a maximum of +7.4 kcal/mol at approximately 75° and further coordination to the lithium atom brings a stabilization of only 2.9 kcal/mol at 80° (Figure 8). Further rotation forces the inversion of the N(1)Me group, allowing its effective conjugation with the aromatic core, which noticeably stabilizes the system but nevertheless leaves the process thermodynamically unfavorable.

translation_unit_protected_translated_te: 据我们所知，这是该效应在邻位锂代苯胺中的首次体现。其原因在于，该效应通常被导向基团与锂原子之间更强的配位作用所“掩盖”。因此，根据我们的量子化学计算，在2-锂代-N,N-二甲基苯胺与甲苯的络合物中，NMe₂ 基团的旋转首先导致电子能量小幅升高，在约 30° 时达到最大值 +0.6 kcal/mol（图 7）。进一步旋转则通过氮与锂的配位产生稳定化作用，在 120° 时稳定化能达 −6.8 kcal/mol。总体而言，共轭能的损失极小，不影响简单苯胺中的卤素–锂交换，仅在类似 12b 这样的张紧底物中才变得显著。例如，在 12b·Tol 中，N(2)Me 基团的类似旋转导致电子能量大幅升高，在约 75° 时达到最大值 +7.4 kcal/mol，而与锂原子的进一步配位仅在 80° 时带来 2.9 kcal/mol 的稳定化（图 8）。继续旋转迫使 N(1)Me 基团发生翻转，使其能够与芳香核心有效共轭，这虽然显著稳定了体系，但仍使该过程在热力学上不利。
